entries.title: Internet-facing RDP discovered on Windows bastion host
entries.description: Weekly external attack-surface sweep found TCP/3389 (RDP) reachable from the internet on a Windows Server bastion host, outside of the approved jump-host allowlist. RDP exposure is a top initial-access vector for ransomware affiliates per current threat reporting.
entries.recommendedAction: Restrict RDP to the VPN/jump-host network range via host firewall/NSG rule, and enforce NLA + MFA for any remaining external RDP access.

entries.title: OpenSSH regression allows authentication bypass under non-default config
entries.description: Vendor advisory flags a regression in OpenSSH server affecting hosts with a specific PAM configuration, potentially allowing authentication to be bypassed. Confirmed present on one internal Linux host during config audit.
entries.recommendedAction: Upgrade OpenSSH to the vendor-patched version immediately; this host handles internal authentication traffic.
